## Download

- **Windows:** `SKAZI.Bundle.Setup.exe`
- **Mac (Apple Silicon + Intel):** `SKAZI.Bundle.pkg` (VST3, Audio Units and apps)

Already have an older SKAZI Bundle? Install this one over it: your projects keep their sounds.

## Install

1. Close your DAW.
2. Run the installer.
   - **Windows** shows "Windows protected your PC" (the installer isn't signed): click **More info, then Run anyway**.
   - **Mac:** right-click the `.pkg`, choose **Open**, then **Open** again.
3. Open your DAW and rescan plugins. Everything is under **SKAZI**.

Windows installs to `C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3\SKAZI` (plugins) and `C:\Program Files\SKAZI` (apps).
Uninstall from Settings > Apps > **SKAZI Bundle**.
